rows.03:2f9c:
"I need help!
You, my senior, who felt the same way I do!
Please, help me!"{p}...What do you think happened?
rows.03:3038: It's too frightening for me to even imagine
rows.03:3058:
...No voice answered.
I mean, that notebook was fishy to begin with.
It could've been somebody's prank.
That's what anybody would normally think, right?
But Tadokoro didn't give up.
And he shouted again.
"Please! I'm begging you!
Help me!
I want to meet you!"
He was grasping at straws.
Tadokoro wished from the bottom of his heart to meet him.{p}
rows.03:3470:
"I understand how you feel...
I understand it so well it hurts.
I can feel it like it's right in my hands."
The bodiless voice sympathized with Tadokoro.
And it told him how bitter it had felt, too.
"I understand, I really do.
It must have been so frustrating.
If I'd been there back then, I definitely could have helped you.
When I think that I couldn't help you, I'm so sad I can't stand it."
The two of them talked until dawn.
And as the sun was coming up, the voice said:
"...Now, go on home for today.
I have to go back too.
If you'd like, come anytime.
There's only so much I can do, but I want to help you, little by little."
"Thank you so much!"
And then the voice was gone.{p}

rows.03:3a14:
So that night, Tadokoro asked the voice.
He asked it to help him.
"I see.
...There's only so much I can do.
But you're just like me, aren't you?
I suppose I could help you.
...Yes, you're worth helping."
"Really?!"
Tadokoro jumped for joy.
"...Yes, really.
But if I'm going to help you, I'll have to show myself.
I'm going to appear in front of you now, so would you keep your eyes closed until I say it's okay?"
"Okay. I will."{p}
